moodys._note: Hurley historically Ba1 from Moody's, BBB- from Fitch (split rating: Moody's one notch into HY, Fitch IG)

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch affirmed BBB- on Series 2010, 2013A and 2013B bonds (~$84.1M debt).
Fitch affirmed BBB- IDR. Variable operating margins, strong market position, somewhat thin capital ratios.
Moody's affirmed Ba1 but revised outlook to Negative from Stable. Expected modest margin performance in FY2019 driving concern.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's outlook degraded from Stable to Negative in early 2019 — preliminary downgrade signal. Fitch maintained Stable. Split signal across agencies, but Moody's negative outlook is the binding constraint. Note: Hurley is municipal (City of Flint) hospital with weak underlying demographics — Flint water crisis context (2014-15) still impacting payor mix.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Industry-typical estimates for municipal safety-net hospital with weak demographics (Flint, MI). Debt amount of $84.1M confirmed by Fitch. Variable operating margins flagged by Fitch — could be -0.5% to 2% range.

_research_notes: Municipal safety-net hospital. Weak demographic base in Flint. Heavy Medicaid mix. Variable margins. Moody's outlook degradation in Jan 2019 = leading indicator. Split-rated credit. Resilience driven by indispensable safety-net role.
